narrative.intro: Reed Technology and Information Services obligated $218M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Reed Technology and Information Services received 1 award so far this fiscal year, yielding an average award size of $218M and obligations up 27.0% year over year. Historical obligations show Reed Technology and Information Services at $175M in FY21, $185M in FY22, $198M in FY23, $199M in FY24, and $172M in FY25. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. All figures reported are contract obligations except where tables note award-value figures as total contract values.
